basic_details.job_title: Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Clerk, Stenographer, Peon Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Court, Madhubani needs one Clerk, one Stenographer and one Peon (3 posts) on contract basis for its Evening Courts, and only retired Civil Court employees who retired within the last three years may apply. The application in the Annexure-I form must be submitted by 10 December 2026 at 05:00 PM (the extended last date), and candidates report for the walk-in interview at 04:35 PM on 17 December 2026 in the Civil Court Campus, Madhubani. The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani, in continuity to its notice dated 17 November 2026.

qualification.details: Eligibility: The engagement will be made from retired Civil Court employees who have retired within the last three years, prior to the period when the selection is being made for Evening Courts. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the application form only asks candidates to state it. Age limit: Should not be more than 65 years as on date of application. Remuneration: The employee will receive 50% of their last drawn pay plus applicable DA and TA. No other allowance is named in the notice. Nature of appointment: Purely contractual; it can be terminated at any time as per the direction of the Patna High Court. Period of engagement: As decided by the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna. Working hours: A minimum of 5 hours on each working day, with flexibility for the Patna High Court to modify these suggested timings based on local conditions and requirements. | Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility conditions of each post.

selection_process: Selection is on the basis of personal interaction. Candidates must report for the walk-in-interview process at 04:35 PM on 17 December 2026 in the Civil Court Campus
Madhubani. Candidates reporting after the scheduled time will not be entertained. The venue
date and time of the selection process may change due to administrative reasons; any change will be notified on the Website of District Court
important_instructions: Candidates must make their own arrangements for stay and travel; no assistance will be provided. Candidates should check the Website of District Court, Madhubani regularly for latest updates. The direction of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications will be final and binding upon the applicant. The candidature can be cancelled even after selection or joining if any information in the form is found incorrect.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The Annexure-I form asks for: Post applied for, name in block letters, date of birth and educational qualification Age as on 30.11.2026 and date of retirement Name of the Civil Court from which retired and post held at the time of retirement Last pay drawn and last drawn Basic Pay PPO No., AADHAR No. and PAN No., each with a copy enclosed Complete residential address, mobile number, email ID and any additional relevant information The form ends with a signed declaration, with place and date, that the particulars are true, that the candidature may be cancelled even after selection or joining if any discrepancy is found, that the candidate was clear from vigilance angle at the time of retirement, and that the candidate accepts all the terms and conditions of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To assist the Evening Court for disposal of judicial cases involving summary trials, dishonor of cheques and public nuisance matters. These cases involve similar legal issues that do not require prolonged hearings.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form in Annexure-I, signed with the declaration Copy of PPO Copy of AADHAR Copy of PAN A declaration regarding pendency of any criminal cases against the candidate, if so At the selection process, candidates must bring the originals of all their testimonials and educational qualification certificates. The selected candidate must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of personal interaction. Candidates must report for the walk-in-interview process at 04:35 PM on 17 December 2026 in the Civil Court Campus, Madhubani. Candidates reporting after the scheduled time will not be entertained. The venue, date and time of the selection process may change due to administrative reasons; any change will be notified on the Website of District Court, Madhubani.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must make their own arrangements for stay and travel; no assistance will be provided. Candidates should check the Website of District Court, Madhubani regularly for latest updates. The direction of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Madhubani in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications will be final and binding upon the applicant. The candidature can be cancelled even after selection or joining if any information in the form is found incorrect.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in Madhubani District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one each of Clerk, Stenographer and Peon for the Evening Courts in the District Court, Madhubani.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application has been extended till 10 December 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Madhubani Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired Civil Court employees who retired within the last three years, prior to the period when the selection is made for Evening Courts, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be more than 65 years as on date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What salary will be paid?
faq.answer: The employee will receive 50% of their last drawn pay plus applicable DA and TA.

faq.question: Q6. Are any allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, applicable DA and TA are paid in addition to 50% of the last drawn pay; the notice names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill up the prescribed application form in Annexure-I, enclose copies of the PPO, Aadhaar and PAN, and submit it by 10 December 2026 at 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process and when is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of personal interaction; candidates must report at 04:35 PM on 17 December 2026 in the Civil Court Campus, Madhubani, and late reporting will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the direction of the Patna High Court, and its period is decided by the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna.

faq.question: Q10. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: The staff must work a minimum of 5 hours on each working day, and the Patna High Court may modify these timings based on local conditions and requirements.
